jobs.description:
WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH
 

 
 

Within Nike's European Logistics Campus, supply chain is at the heart of the athlete and consumer experience
 

Our ambition is to accelerate service, efficiency and cost improvements by combining data-driven problem solving with end-to-end solution design.
 

Within our organization, there are different teams where you could bring your expertise, with a focus on areas such as transportation, planning and operations.
 

You will work closely with operational teams, analysts, specialists, managers, and internal and external partners across our logistics network. Together, we connect expertise across functions, distribution centers, channels and value streams to improve performance faster and at scale.
 

You will contribute to one strong team, focused on delivering for athletes and consumers while continuously raising the bar in logistics.
 

 
 

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
 

 
 
 

• Own and improve day-to-day performance: Monitor supply chain and logistics performance, identify deviations and translate insights into clear actions with the right owners and timing. 

• Turn data into decisions: Combine operational information and analytical insights to identify root causes, opportunities, risks and practical recommendations. 

• Automate day-to-day workflows: Identify repetitive, manual or fragmented activities and help redesign them into simpler, standardized and automated workflows. Partner with process owners and technology teams to define requirements, test solutions, support implementation and track adoption and value. 

• Drive continuous improvement: Structure and deliver improvement initiatives with clear scope, milestones, risks, expected outcomes and measurable business value. 

• Design end-to-end solutions: Work across functions, distribution centers, channels and value streams to connect local improvements to the wider logistics network. 

• Support implementation: Stay close to the operation from problem definition through testing, deployment, stabilization and handover. 

• Build scalable ways of working: Create clear processes, documentation, dashboards and routines that make improvements sustainable and reusable across teams. 

• Engage stakeholders: Facilitate discussions, align different perspectives and communicate progress, decisions and next steps clearly. 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 

 
 
 

• ACT WITH URGENCYYou don’t wait for the perfect conditions. You step in, take ownership and stay close to the action. You turn insights into decisions and decisions into momentum. 

• LEAD WITH HOWHow you win matters. You bring analytical thinking and a problem-solving mindset, challenge the status quo and make the complex simple. You communicate with clarity, bring people along and build strong partnerships across the business. 

• BE FLEXIBLEThe game can change fast, and you’re ready to move with it. You thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment, navigate ambiguity with confidence and adapt as priorities shift. You’re curious to learn different parts of the supply chain and ready to contribute wherever you can create impact. 

• PLAY TO WINYou keep your eyes on the finish line. You focus on solutions that work, value that can be measured and improvements that make a real difference. You don’t stop at the idea. You help bring it to life.  

 
 

YOUR SPORTS BAG CONTAINS
 
 

• A bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent professional experience, in supply chain, logistics, engineering, business analytics or a related field. 

• You bring a strong interest in supply chain and have built relevant knowledge or hands-on experience through your education, internships, projects or professional experience in areas such as supply chain, distribution, logistics, project delivery or process improvement. 

• Strong project-management skills, with experience structuring work around clear deliverables, milestones, risks and expected outcomes. 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data and operational information into clear insights and recommendations. 

• Experience identifying workflow improvement opportunities and translating business needs into standardized or automated processes. Experience with workflow, analytics or automation tools is an asset. 

• The ability to work independently while collaborating across teams, functions and organizational levels. 

• Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills. 

• Professional proficiency in English. Dutch is an asset. 

• Curiosity, adaptability and a willingness to learn new processes, technologies and areas of the supply chain. 

• Experience with analytics tools, Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, process mapping, simulation or supply chain technology is an asset.  

 
 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 
 

• Operational issues are translated into clear actions and sustainable improvements. 

• Manual day-to-day activities are simplified, standardized or automated where this adds value. 

• Projects deliver measurable service, cost, quality or productivity improvements. 

• Solutions are implemented successfully, adopted by the operation and scalable beyond one team or process. 

• Stakeholders understand the priorities, decisions, ownership and next steps.

Would you like to work for an international company where technology and healthcare come together?
 

As a Technical Support Officer, you will become part of a close-knit team, supporting customers with high-quality software solutions for the medical sector. You'll benefit from a comprehensive training programme and plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.
 

Your responsibilities as a Technical Support Officer:
 

As a Technical Support Officer, you are the first point of contact for customers who need technical assistance. You primarily support French-speaking customers, while also communicating regularly in English with colleagues and customers from other countries.
 
 
 
• Provide technical support to customers regarding software, hardware, and connectivity issues. 
 
• Assist customers via phone, email, and remote support, primarily in French. 
 
• Analyse technical issues and work together with customers to find the most suitable solution. 
 
• Guide customers through software installations, updates, and configurations. 
 
• Accurately register and follow up on support requests in the CRM system. 
 
• Escalate more complex issues to specialised colleagues when necessary. 
 
• Work closely with colleagues and other internal departments to resolve complex technical queries. 

Who are we looking for?
 
 
 
• You have initial experience in Technical Support, Customer Support, or an IT Help Desk role. 
 
• You have a strong interest in software, IT, and technology. 
 
• You are fluent in both French and English, both spoken and written, as you will use these languages daily when communicating with customers and colleagues. 
 
• You are solution-oriented and remain organised when dealing with multiple requests at the same time. 
 
• You are able to prioritise effectively and manage your workload efficiently. 
 
• A secondary education diploma (A2 level) is sufficient. Above all, we value your motivation, eagerness to learn, and passion for technology.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.Join our Technical Department team as a Production Support Technician! In this role, you will be responsible for developing work instructions and methods, as well as providing the necessary production tools to ensure smooth workflow in the workshops and high-quality outcomes for our customers.

Your role:

• You analyze the technical information obtained from the manufacturer via the Engineering department and integrate it into the ERP system.
• You are responsible for writing, updating and translating the technical working documents, taking into account the strict application of the aviation regulations and the instructions of the manufacturer. You ensure the implementation of the technical working documents in the workshops and ensure their correct application.
• You participate in the continuous improvement processes within the department.
• You participate and/or coordinate the improvements of the current working methods and introduce possible new technologies. You ensure the sharing of information as a result of 'retour d'expérience' (RETEX) by means of an infoshop for the mechanics in case of new or improved work instructions.
• You provide technical support to the workshops, both theoretical and practical (if necessary), and look for solutions in case of problems in order to avoid a delay of the production process. You ensure the delivery of the necessary tooling to the workshops and guarantee its correct use by drawing up adequate work instructions.
• You participate in the industrialisation (MRO and NEW) of new types of engines.
• You make repair proposals to the manufacturer in order to make the parts repairable.
• You draw up specifications for the means of production.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in electromechanics or aeronautics, preferably with a first experience in repair methods.
• You speak French or Dutch, with a good knowledge of the other national language and you are willing to improve your skills. You also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• You have good knowledge of electromechanics, mechanics and repair technologies.
• You have knowledge of engines and engine parts.
• You are an analytical and synthetic person and can anticipate.
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and you are willing to support your colleagues.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to develop business across the Middle East and Africa.Our client is an international wholesaler of industrial sealing solutions, supplying technical distributors and industrial trading partners. Its product range includes O-rings, industrial seals and customised sealing products for a wide variety of applications.The company is looking for a commercially driven professional who enjoys approaching potential customers, developing new accounts and turning opportunities into actual sales.This position has a strong business development focus. You will work closely with the External Sales Representative to expand the customer portfolio across the MEA region while continuing to develop relationships with existing clients.What will you do? 
• Actively identify and approach potential B2B customers across the Middle East and Africa. 
• Prospect for new business opportunities and open new customer accounts. 
• Follow up on commercial leads and convert opportunities into sales. 
• Build relationships with new customers and develop long-term business opportunities. 
• Maintain and expand existing customer accounts. 
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling. 
• Prepare quotations and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process orders and respond to customer enquiries. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Understand customer requirements and propose suitable sealing solutions. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative on commercial activities and customer development. 
• Monitor sales opportunities and report on commercial progress. 
• Provide professional customer service and ensure timely follow-up of requests.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have experience in B2B sales and/or customer service. 
• You genuinely enjoy prospecting and approaching new customers. 
• You are confident initiating commercial conversations and following up on opportunities. 
• You are fluent in English and French, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage, but not a requirement. 
• Experience with customers in the Middle East or Africa is a plus. 
• Experience selling technical or industrial products is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general business software. 
• You communicate clearly and know how to build professional relationships. 
• You take initiative and are motivated by commercial results. 
• You can work independently while maintaining close contact with your sales colleagues. 
• You are customer-oriented, persistent and organised in your approach.

For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to support and develop customer relationships across Eastern Europe.Our client is an international wholesaler specialising in industrial sealing solutions, including O-rings, technical seals and customised sealing products. The company supplies technical distributors and industrial trading partners worldwide.You will join a small, internationally oriented sales team where customer relationships, technical understanding and commercial initiative are equally important.Your focus will be on managing existing accounts while identifying opportunities to develop new business. Approximately 70% of your activities will involve existing customers, with the remaining 30% focused on new customer acquisition.What will you do? 
• Manage and develop relationships with existing B2B customers. 
• Identify potential customers and open new accounts. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative to develop sales opportunities. 
• Prepare quotations, calculate prices and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process customer orders and monitor their progress. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Identify cross-selling opportunities within the existing product range. 
• Encourage customers to use the company's digital ordering tools. 
• Handle customer enquiries, complaints and commercial requests. 
• Keep customer information accurate and up to date in the internal system. 
• Develop an understanding of customer applications, market developments and competitors. 
• Monitor commercial opportunities and report on sales activities. 
• Support colleagues when needed and contribute to the daily operation of the sales department.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have at least 4 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably involving technical products. 
• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Polish, Czech or another Eastern European language is a strong advantage. 
• Knowledge of French and/or Arabic is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and other business software. 
• You enjoy maintaining customer relationships and identifying commercial opportunities. 
• You communicate clearly and confidently with international customers. 
• You are organised and capable of managing several customer requests simultaneously. 
• You take initiative and follow up on commercial opportunities without needing constant supervision. 
• You work well in a small team and remain focused when priorities change. 
• An interest in industrial products and technical applications will help you succeed in this role.

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, produces and distributes an extensive range of analog and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications.

Are you about to finish your degree with a thesis? Do you want to apply your software engineering skills to a real world product used in medical imaging?

We are offering a thesis position focused on modernizing a legacy software component and better integration into the existing quality assurance infrastructure.

During your project you will use C++, our internal development framework, AI-assisted development tools and modern continuous integration (CI) practices to migrate an existing code base to a new framework and establish a robust automated testing environment. You will collaborate closely with imaging specialists and development experts to ensure the software meets the high quality standards needed for medical applications.

Job Description

Are you about to finish your degree with a thesis? Do you want to apply your software engineering skills to a real world product used in medical imaging?

We are offering a thesis position focused on modernizing a legacy software component and better integration into the existing quality assurance infrastructure.

During your project you will use C++, our internal development framework, AI-assisted development tools and modern continuous integration (CI) practices to migrate an existing code base to a new framework and establish a robust automated testing environment. You will collaborate closely with imaging specialists and development experts to ensure the software meets the high quality standards needed for medical applications.

Your Role
 
• Design, implement, and improve automated unit and regression tests 
• Apply AI-assisted development tools to accelerate code migration, test generation, 
refactoring, and documentation
 
• Establish and monitor code coverage metrics 
• Integrate testing, coverage analysis, and regression checks into the existing CI/CD pipeline 
• Identify opportunities to streamline and standardize future software migration efforts 
• Use and improve best practices for integrating AI coding assistants into software modernization workflows 
• Collaborate with senior software developers and imaging experts to validate functionality and quality 
Your Profile
 
• Bachelor's or Master's student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field 
• Strong affinity with software development, testing, automation and development infrastructure 
• Experience with C++ development, experience with other programming languages is a plus 
• Familiarity with git and CI/CD concepts is an asset 
• Curious and eager to explore new tools, technologies, and environments 
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English/Dutch and a collaborative mindset

Our client operates in the logistics sector, specializing in warehouse operations and inventory management. The company focuses on the efficient handling, storage and distribution of goods. Quality, accuracy and safety are essential in its daily operations. Employees work together to ensure smooth inbound and outbound processes. You will join a professional warehouse environment where teamwork and efficiency are key.
Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced orderpicker looking for a new challenge in logistics? Do you enjoy working in a warehouse where accuracy and efficiency are important? Then this might be the perfect job for you!For our client, we are looking for a motivated orderpicker to support daily inbound and outbound warehouse operations.

Your main responsibilities:

• Picking and preparing orders using an RF scanner.
• Receiving, checking and storing incoming goods (inbound).
• Preparing, packing and dispatching outgoing orders (outbound).
• Keeping the warehouse clean, organized and safe.

We are looking for an experienced warehouse worker who is reliable, accurate and ready to get things done.

• You have previous experience in orderpicking or warehouse operations.
• You have experience working with RF scanners.
• You speak English, which is required for safety and communication.
• Knowledge of Dutch or Spanish is a plus.
• Experience operating a forklift or reachtruck is an advantage.
• You are flexible and willing to work in three rotating shifts. (Early shift: 07:40 – 16:15, Day shift: 08:40 – 17:15, Late shift: 12:40 – 21:15)

Do you have experience in woodworking and take pride in delivering high-quality craftsmanship?

We are looking for a Production Worker Woodworking to help manufacture and assemble bespoke kitchens and custom-made furniture in a modern production environment.

Salary: starting at 17 euro bruto per hour + meal vouchers

• Producing and assembling custom kitchens and fixed furniture solutions.

• Working on high-end interior projects with great attention to detail and finishing quality.

• Reading and interpreting technical drawings and plans.

• Operating woodworking machinery and tools.

• Contributing to an efficient and smooth production process.

• You have completed a technical or vocational education in woodworking.

• You have previous experience as a woodworker, cabinet maker, or production worker in a similar role.

• You can read and interpret technical drawings.

• You possess strong technical skills and practical insight.

• You work in an organized and structured manner.

• You are flexible and able to perform well under pressure.

• You communicate fluently in English.

• You enjoy working as part of a team but can also work independently when required.

Are you a real night owl and do you enjoy an active, hands-on job? Then we may have the perfect job for you! We are looking for a motivated Warehouse Operator to join the permanent night shift. You will work for a stable and growing company where you can count on proper training, a great team atmosphere and an attractive salary package. Your responsibilities As a Warehouse Operator, you play an important role in the logistics process. You make sure that goods are processed correctly and that orders are ready for shipment. Your tasks include:
 

 
• Receiving, checking and storing incoming goods
 
• Picking orders using voice picking and/or scanning
 
• Preparing orders accurately and on time for transport
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Moving goods using an electric pallet truck and/or reach truck
 
• Keeping the warehouse clean, organised and safe
 
• Following safety, hygiene and quality procedures (HACCP)
 
• Working in a chilled environment, including a freezer area 

Who are we looking for? You don't need years of experience for this position. Motivation and the right attitude are just as important! We are looking for someone who:
 

 
• Preferably has experience as a warehouse operator, although motivated candidates without experience are also welcome
 
• Works accurately and responsibly
 
• Is not afraid of physical work and enjoys being hands-on
 
• Can work independently as well as in a team
 
• Speaks and understands Dutch and/or English
 
• Has experience with an electric pallet truck or reach truck (a valid certificate is a plus)
 
• Is comfortable working in a cold/freezer environment
 
• Is willing to work the permanent night shift

jobs.occupation: CE truck driver for national transport - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 

• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Between 5 to 15 stops/day

• Never on weekends or on holidays

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby + truck cannot be taken home)

Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

We are looking for an enthusiastic grinder for our production department.

Our client is an international player in modular systems for events, stand construction and so on.

Duties:

- grinding and deburring of aluminum profiles.

- alternating between serial work and piece work

- entering and processing orders in the computer

You have experience within the metal sector or have completed technical studies.

You can work with the computer

You have a good command of the English language

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - Saturday or weekdays
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

Shape the architecture behind the next generation of AI supercomputers.
 

Join imec and design the future of AI computing
 

What if your architectural decisions could influence the future of artificial intelligence at the scale of the world's most advanced computing systems?
At imec, you will work at the intersection of AI, semiconductor innovation, and large-scale computing architectures. Together with leading experts in computing systems, chip technology, software, and artificial intelligence, you will help define how future AI infrastructure is built, optimized, and scaled.
This is not a product maintenance role. It is an opportunity to explore breakthrough architectures that could shape the next decade of AI and high-performance computing.
 

What you will do
 

As a Principal AI & High-Performance Computing Architect, you will drive innovation across the entire computing stack, from AI applications and system software to processors, accelerators, and semiconductor technologies.
You will create models, simulations, and design explorations that help identify the most promising paths toward future AI computing systems that deliver significant improvements in performance, energy efficiency, and sustainability.
Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Exploring architectural solutions for next-generation AI and high-performance computing clusters. 

• Analysing the behaviour and performance characteristics of large-scale AI workloads. 

• Developing performance models that identify bottlenecks and opportunities for innovation. 

• Evaluating future processor, accelerator, memory, and system designs. 

• Collaborating with experts in computer architecture, AI, semiconductor technology, system software, and modelling. 

• Defining requirements for future AI computing platforms and processor architectures. 

• Guiding strategic research directions through data-driven performance analysis and projections. 

• Contributing to breakthrough innovations that improve performance, energy efficiency, operational cost, and environmental impact. 

Who you are
 
 

• Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or relevant STEM degree, with at least around 8 years of experience.   

• Experience with performance analysis, engineering, and optimization of HPC applications, such as molecular dynamics and computational fluid dynamics,  

• Experience in AI for HPC is a plus.   

• Experience with distributed AI/ML applications, such as LLM training and inference.   

• Experience in system performance modeling ranging from a single device (e.g. a GPU) to a machine scale (e.g. a cluster).  

• Good understanding of GPU (preferably XPU) system architectures, distributed programming models, runtime resource management, and microarchitecture.   

• Strong programming ability in C++ and Python. CUDA knowledge is considered a plus.   

• Your communication and interpersonal skills enable you to work in a dynamic, distributed team. You actively share experiences and knowledge with colleagues. A history of mentoring more junior engineers and interns is a huge plus.   

• We are looking for your excellent communication skills in English, as you will work in a multicultural team and together with our partners.

18 state-of-the-art meeting spaces, newly refreshed extensive meeting- and event facilities and a strong 
international corporate clientele, the hotel is recognized as a premier destination for meetings, conferences 
and business travel. Join a dynamic commercial team where innovation, relationship-building and driving

Ready to hunt, win and grow?
 

We're looking for a driven Sales Manager who loves opening new doors, building strong client relationships 
and closing deals. This is a true business development role. Your mission is simple: generate new business 
across our Corporate, MICE, Leisure and Airline segments and help position Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport 
as the preferred hotel in the market.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Hunt for new business opportunities and build your own client portfolio. 

• Negotiate and close commercial agreements. 

• Develop and manage a strong sales pipeline using our CRM. 

• Identify market trends and new business opportunities. 

• Work closely with our commercial and operational teams to deliver outstanding guest 

Who you are• A natural hunter with a passion for sales.

 or equivalent in Hotel Management/Business Administration, 
or equivalent experience.

EDR Antwerp Shipyard is the largest shipyard in Belgium, specialised in ship maintenance and repairs, hull treatment and marine construction. Challenging activities require skilful and motivated team members. Over 150 vessels annually are repaired and maintained at our shipyard in Antwerp, and projects are performed on board vessels across the world.
 

As a 
Crane Operator, you play a key role in ensuring safe, efficient and well organised lifting operations within and around our dry dock. You will primarily operate one of our 
five cranes and support a wide range of dockside activities that contribute directly to vessel repair and maintenance projects. You will join a close knit team of experienced crane operators where teamwork and safety are central.
 

RESPONSIBILITIES
 

• Operate one of the 
five cranes on site, including a Wolff tower crane, a Wolff luffing jib crane and three fully restored shipyard cranes with lifting capacities of up to 100 tonnes
 

• Carry out lifting operations safely and efficiently in accordance with site procedures and operational requirements
 

• Support signalling and guidance of lifting movements in areas with limited visibility or restricted access
 

• Assist with dry dock operations (such as the positioning of docking blocks)
 

• Actively support crane operations by maintaining clear lifting zones, monitoring traffic routes and minimising downtime
 

• Coordinate incoming materials and deliveries, ensuring safe and appropriate storage locations are assigned
 

• Serve as a communication link between subcontractors, shipyard teams, vessel crews and fellow crane operators
 

• Provide basic rigging support and assist colleagues in selecting and using suitable lifting equipment
 

• Maintain good order, cleanliness and safety standards around the dry dock area
 

• Identify, report and document damage, deviations and unsafe situations
 

• Support other operational activities on site when crane work is temporarily unavailable
 

 
 

#ontmoetingsdag

• Good knowledge of English, which is the primary language used for operational communication, radio contact and coordination with subcontractors and vessel crews
 

• Knowledge of Dutch is an advantage for internal coordination and site instructions. Knowledge of Polish and/or Romanian is considered a strong asset
 

• Strong safety awareness and the ability to maintain oversight and prioritise effectively in a dynamic work environment
 

• Confident communicator with a practical and collaborative approach
 

• Hands on attitude and a consistent commitment to agreed procedures and safety standards
 

• Experience with crane operations, forklifts and/or mobile elevated work platforms is highly advantageous
 

• Flexibility to align working hours (daytime hours) with operational requirements, deliveries and lifting schedules
 

• Weekend work may occur, but is not mandatory and will be arranged in consultation with the other colleagues
